ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1S1 Slow Search 256 extends the validated JS1.1S playtest for RimWorld 1.5. Ordinary JobPackages retain JS1.1R behavior. JobGiver-owned GenClosest.ClosestThingReachable searches backed by a live ThingRequest source of at least 256 candidates may use the selective nearest-first path; 128-255 candidate sources are recorded for telemetry but remain on JS1.1R/Vanilla. The original WorkGiver validator still runs on the main thread and final reachability is checked with live map.reachability.CanReach. The goal is to reduce the remaining JobGiver P95/P99 tail after JS1.1S cut the measured maximum spike. JR1/JR1.1 Regionwise and global Region.Allows experiments remain retired. ReachProfile keeps JS1.1R prediction/build behavior and the embedded rolling 8192/8 soft fuse, 3600-frame live cooldown, 256-clean forced-shadow probation and 16/256 emergency hard fuse.
